newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar remains soggy, ends lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar remains soggy, ends lower.

text.p: White sugar futures remained unimpressive during Tuesday evening LIFFE trading, and finished with losses from Monday.
Traders said the market took its cue from a bearish performance in New York raws this afternoon.
March ended the day trading at $310.20 a tonne, a $1.00 loss from Monday, with total LIFFE turnover just 1,517 lots.

Technical analysts pegged December's support at $310.00 after the $315.00 level was broken on Monday. But the relative strength indicator (RSI) could also bounce higher as it hovered in oversold territory.
